SKU.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to each product for inventory and sales tracking.

SKU_Name.description: Descriptive product name including brand, type, and specification.

Category.description: Top-level product classification (e.g., "Auto Lighting", "Kitchen & Small Appliances", "Outdoor Living & Patio").

Subcategory.description: Secondary product classification within a category (e.g., "Automotive", "Home & Living").

Fineline.description: Short code representing the finest level of product classification (e.g., "LED", "AFR", "BBQ").

Fineline_Name.description: Full descriptive name of the fineline grouping (e.g., "Air Fryers", "Coolers & Hydration", "Yoga & Recovery").

Vendor.description: Name of the supplier or manufacturer providing the product.

Brand.description: Consumer-facing brand name under which the product is sold (e.g., "LumiPro", "Ninja", "CANVAS", "Woods").

New_SKU_Flag.description: Indicates whether the SKU is new to the assortment. "Y" = new; "N" = existing.

Status.description: Current lifecycle status. "ACT" = Active; "FD" = Fade/Discontinue (being phased out).

Retail_Price.description: Current selling price to the consumer, in dollars.

Cost.description: Unit cost to the retailer from the vendor, in dollars.

TY_POS_Units.full_name: This Year Point of Sale Units
TY_POS_Units.description: Total units sold at the register (point of sale) in the current year.

LY_POS_Units.full_name: Last Year Point of Sale Units
LY_POS_Units.description: Total units sold at the register in the prior year, used for year-over-year comparison.

TY_POS_Dollars.full_name: This Year Point of Sale Dollars
TY_POS_Dollars.description: Total retail sales revenue in dollars for the current year.

LY_POS_Dollars.full_name: Last Year Point of Sale Dollars
LY_POS_Dollars.description: Total retail sales revenue in dollars for the prior year.

TY_RVS.full_name: This Year Retail Value of Shipments
TY_RVS.description: Dollar value of inventory shipped to retail locations in the current year, measured at retail price.

LY_RVS.full_name: Last Year Retail Value of Shipments
LY_RVS.description: Dollar value of inventory shipped to retail locations in the prior year.

TY_EGM_Dollars.full_name: This Year Earned Gross Margin Dollars
TY_EGM_Dollars.description: Gross margin earned in dollars for the current year, calculated as revenue minus cost of goods sold plus vendor allowances.

LY_EGM_Dollars.full_name: Last Year Earned Gross Margin Dollars
LY_EGM_Dollars.description: Gross margin earned in dollars for the prior year.

TY_EGM_Pct.full_name: This Year Earned Gross Margin Percentage
TY_EGM_Pct.description: EGM as a percentage of sales for the current year, indicating the margin rate.

LY_EGM_Pct.full_name: Last Year Earned Gross Margin Percentage
LY_EGM_Pct.description: EGM as a percentage of sales for the prior year.

QTD_POS_Dollars.full_name: Quarter to Date Point of Sale Dollars
QTD_POS_Dollars.description: Cumulative retail sales revenue from the start of the current quarter to the present date.

YTD_POS_Dollars.full_name: Year to Date Point of Sale Dollars
YTD_POS_Dollars.description: Cumulative retail sales revenue from January 1 of the current year to the present date.

R12_POS_Dollars.full_name: Rolling 12 Months Point of Sale Dollars
R12_POS_Dollars.description: Total retail sales revenue over the most recent trailing 12-month window, updated monthly.

Store_Count.description: Number of retail store locations currently carrying this SKU.

Season.description: Retail season code indicating the selling period (e.g., "S3 Spring" = Season 3, Spring).

YTD_TY_POS.full_name: Year to Date This Year Point of Sale
YTD_TY_POS.description: Cumulative units sold at point of sale from the start of the year to date, current year.

YTD_LY_POS.full_name: Year to Date Last Year Point of Sale
YTD_LY_POS.description: Cumulative units sold at point of sale from the start of the year to date, prior year.

YTD_TY_Ship.full_name: Year to Date This Year Shipments
YTD_TY_Ship.description: Cumulative units shipped to stores from the start of the year to date, current year.

YTD_LY_Ship.full_name: Year to Date Last Year Shipments
YTD_LY_Ship.description: Cumulative units shipped to stores from the start of the year to date, prior year.

Retail_Inv_TY.description: Current on-hand inventory units at retail store locations.

Corp_Inv_TY.description: Current on-hand inventory units at the corporate distribution center or warehouse.

Current_POS_Forecast.description: Projected total units expected to be sold for the remainder of the season based on current demand signals.

Current_Ship_Forecast.description: Projected total units expected to be shipped to stores for the remainder of the season.

Open_PO_Qty.description: Units on outstanding purchase orders placed with the vendor but not yet received.

Planned_Purchase_Qty.description: Units planned to be ordered from the vendor in future purchase orders to meet demand.

Weeks_of_Supply.description: Estimated number of weeks current inventory (retail + corporate) will last at the current rate of sale.

Corp_Inv_Units_TY.description: On-hand inventory units at the corporate distribution center, current year.

Corp_Inv_Units_LY.description: On-hand inventory units at the corporate distribution center, prior year.

Retail_Inv_Units_TY.description: On-hand inventory units at retail store locations, current year.

Retail_Inv_Units_LY.description: On-hand inventory units at retail store locations, prior year.

YTD_POS_TY.full_name: Year to Date Point of Sale This Year
YTD_POS_TY.description: Cumulative units sold year to date, current year.

YTD_POS_LY.full_name: Year to Date Point of Sale Last Year
YTD_POS_LY.description: Cumulative units sold year to date, prior year.

YTD_POS_Change_Pct.full_name: Year to Date POS Change Percentage
YTD_POS_Change_Pct.description: Percentage change in YTD units sold compared to the prior year.

R8_POS_TY.full_name: Rolling 8 Weeks Point of Sale This Year
R8_POS_TY.description: Total units sold over the most recent trailing 8-week window, current year.

R8_POS_LY.full_name: Rolling 8 Weeks Point of Sale Last Year
R8_POS_LY.description: Total units sold over the comparable trailing 8-week window, prior year.

R8_POS_Change_Pct.description: Percentage change in R8 units sold compared to the prior year's equivalent 8-week window.

YTD_Lost_Sales_Pct.full_name: Year to Date Lost Sales Percentage
YTD_Lost_Sales_Pct.description: Estimated percentage of potential sales lost due to out-of-stock situations year to date.

Vendor_Fill_Rate_Pct.description: Percentage of units ordered from the vendor that were fulfilled and delivered on time.

Ship_Units_TY.description: Total units shipped from the distribution center to retail stores, current year.

Ship_Units_LY.description: Total units shipped from the distribution center to retail stores, prior year.

DDF_Units.description: Units fulfilled directly from the dealer or vendor to the customer or store, bypassing the central distribution center.
